Commentary.Commentary: So we do have a decider! The third ODI will tell us who will win the series. Everything to play for on Wednesday. That game begins 1000 local (0800 GMT). Till then, goodbye and take care!

Fakhar Zaman, is the rightful MAN OF THE MATCH and says that he feels really good but it would have been better if they would have won. States he was talking to everyone and he wanted them to bat 15 to 20 balls and then it would get easy, Informs his plan was to target the small boundaries and it came off well. States they were looking for partnerships but did not get many. Ends by saying he can't say it is his best innings but had they won, then yes.

Temba Bavuma, South African skipper, says he is very happy to win. Further adds Zaman played one of the best innings he has seen and he always out thought the bowlers. Mentions taking wickets was the objective, he was not expecting that kind of onslaught by Fakhar but his bowlers did well to win in the end. Says they have two days of rest now and they want to rest and then it is a matter of looking at the areas where they have done well and win the last ODI.

Babar Azam, the Pakistani skipper, says he saw one of the best innings of his life and Fakhar played brilliantly but he is disappointed he could not finish the game. Adds till the time Zaman was batting, he felt they can win and if he had got support, the result could have been different. Mentions there are quite a positives in this game and they would want to better in the next game and win it.

For South Africa, Nortje was once again the star, Rabada was also good. Phehlukwayo did take a couple but was expensive. Shamsi and Ngidi were not that great. Overall, they will be happy with a win in the end but the margin could have been a lot bigger than what it was.

Chasing a mammoth score, Pakistan got off to a good start despite losing Imam early. However, once Azam fell, the procession started. Within no time they were 5 down and looked down and out. Zaman though continued batting from one end but he fought a lone battle. No other batter scored above 40 and that is not what you want when chasing a big score. Had he got some support, the story could well have been different.

Just a 17 run win in the end for South Africa! Pakistan were 120 for 5 and at that moment, nobody thought they would get this close. Just the one man, Fakhar Zaman, has single-handedly got them near the South African total. He played an innings of a lifetime and this game will surely be remembered for his knock. Very unfortunate for him to not score a double ton but it was a delight to watch him bat.
FOUR! That will be a boundary but its not enough! Length ball, outside off and cut to the point fence. SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 17 RUNS!!
FOUR! Too little too late! Length ball and he clubs it over the man at wide long on and into the fence.
Swing and a miss! This one is full and outside off. Hasnain looks to deposit it in the stands but fails to make any contact.
Slower one, outside off. Hasnain swings hard but misses.
FOUR! Full ball and clubbed over mid off for a boundary.

OUT! RUN OUT! Brilliant throw by the man at long off and a wonderful, wonderful innings by Fakhar comes to an end. Full ball on off and he drills it to long off, he comes back for the second but Aiden Markram hits a bullet throw at the striker's end. Fakhar was nowhere in the picture. Brilliant by de Kock too, he pretends that the throw is being made to the bowler's end and Fakhar slows down in his second run. He falls 7 short of what would have been a wonderful 200 irrespective of the result.

Swing and a miss! Just 7 from the over and Andile Phehlukwayo has done a great job! Length ball on middle, Rauf rightly goes for the slog but misses it completely. Fakhar has been brilliant but can he gets his side over the line?
Full ball, outside off. He can only hit it to sweeper cover. 31 from 7 now.
Excellent running! Full one, outside off and he creams it to long off. Two runs and he moves into the 190's.
DOT BALL! Gold dust! Full and wide outside off. Fakhar looks to slog it to the leg side but misses.
Misses out on this one! Full toss outside off and Fakhar looks to cream it through the off side. He misses and the ball rolls back to de Kock, he doesn't collect it cleanly and is hit on the arm.
FOUR! BANG! WOW! Slower ball outside off, he reaches for it and smacks it to the long off fence.
Full ball again, outside off and Rauf fails to get any bat on it. 15 from the over.
Full ball on off and drilled to sweeper cover for one.
FOUR! What placement! He flicks this full one and bisects the two men at the leg side boundary. The ball races to the mid-wicket fence.
FOUR! Not where he intented but that takes them closer to the target! Full one on off and he looks to go through the on side, he gets an outside edge and the ball flies to the third man fence.
Excellent running! Length ball and he misses his flick, the ball rolls away to the vacant  mid-wicket region and they take a couple.

NOT OUT! Brilliant by Rabada at deep sqaure leg. Fakhar gets a low full toss and he whips it towards deep mid-wicket. Rabada dives and saves a couple of runs. The ball is thrown to keeper and he takes off the bails but Fakhar is back in.
Dot ball! Good over for South Africa, just 5 from it. Length ball on off and Rauf looks to slog it away but misses.
Another single as Fakhar slaps this one to long on.
Full on off and pushed to long on for one.
DROPPED BY BAVUMA! This would have been a blinder and would have been the game! Short and outside off and Fakhar slices it to Bavuma at covers, he leaps up to catch it but fails to hold onto it.
Fails to connect! Length ball and he looks to slog it way, but gets a top edge which thuds in his helmet.
Lengh ball, around off and pushed to point by Fakhar.
Another one! Full and wide outside off. Fakhar leaves and picks up a wide.
Slower one, wide outside off. It goes just past the wide line and is gven by the umpire.
Slower bouncer outside off and pulled down to fine leg. 15 from the over and Fakhar is on strike.

Poor from Shamsi! Slower ball outside off and Fakhar works it to short third man. It should have been one but Shamsi attempts a direct hit at the striker's end and misses. There is no back up and they take an overthrow.
Short and wide outside off. Fakhar works it across towards long on and takes an easy couple.
Slower one again, Fakhar looks to slog sweep this one but is through the shot early. He is hit on the pads.
FOUR! Shot! 8 of the first two balls! Slower ball outside off and he thumps it over mid off and to the ropes.
FOUR! He is playing a blinder here! Full one, on the pads and Fakhar flicks it past short fine leg for one.
Back of a length, around off and Rauf defends it. Very good over for South Africa, a wicket and just the one run from it.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Big wicket as Fakhar now has one less partner! Slower one, on a length and Afridi looks to go big, but only manages to get a top edge. Rabada settles under it and completes the formalities.
Length ball, outside off. Afridi looks to cut but fails to get any bat on it.
Full ball, around off and pushed to mid off for a quick run.
Low full toss, around middle and Fakhar plays it over the bowler's head. The ball goes to long on but the run isn't taken.
Well bowled! Right in the block hole and Fakhar digs it to deep square leg.
Loopy ball, around off and Afridi defends.
A touch shorter this time, around off and Fakhar pushes it to covers for one.
Doesn't connect the sweep this time. The ball races away to the mid-wicket fence. It is cut off by the fielder and no run is taken.
SIX! Three in three for Fakhar! Absolute carnage! Again, tossed up in his half and he deposits it over the square leg fence.
SIX! Two in a row and Shamsi is taking a beating! Fakhar slog sweeps this one over the square leg fence to bring up his 150!
SIX! Ho ho ho! Wow! That is massive! Tossed up outside off and he slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence.
Swing a miss! Short one by Rabada, on the leg stump. Afridi goes for the pull fails to connect. Just 4 from the over.
A touch fuller this time, but the same line. It is pushed to covers.
A length ball, around the fourth stump. Afridi looks to defend but the ball goes past his bat.
Short and wide outsdie off. Afridi goes for the cut but misses.
FOUR! Shot! Now Afridi gets into the act! Full toss on his pads and he just flicks it to the mid-wicket fence.
Length ball, around off and Afridi pushes it to covers. He looks for a run at first but decide against it in the end. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end and Fakhar is forced to dive in.
SIX! Finishes the over in style! Tossed up, on middle and he hits a flat six over mid-wicket.
Full one, on his pads. Fakhar looks to sweep it away but misses.
SIX! That is outta here! Tossed up in his slot and he launches it over mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, chopped to backward point.
Shorter and outside off. Fakhar pushes it to long off.
Shorter and outside off. Fakhar pushes it to covers.
On middle, defended.
Shorter and on middle, Afridi looks to pull but misses.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed towards mid on for one.
FOUR! This is on middle, Zaman pulls it through mid-wicket. Boundary.
SIX! Length and on middle, Zaman heaves it, it goes off the middle and over the mid-wicket fence.
A slower bumper, Zaman looks to pull but misses to get hit on the body.
Powerplay 3 singnaled! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the game.
On the pads, this is worked towards fine leg. No run taken.
Comes down the track again and this is a low full toss, it is hit towards cover for one.
Angled into the pads, Zaman loosk to put bat on ball but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Shorter and on off, it is pushed to covers.
Full and outside off, Zaman comes down the track and swings but misses.
SIX! Makes full use of the Free Hit! A slower one on middle, Zaman lofts it over the long on fence for a biggie.
NO BALL! Outside off, it is guided to point.
Another fuller ball, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Top edge and over the keeper! On middle, Zaman looks to pull but gets a top edge over the keeper for a boundary.
Shorter and on middle, Afridi fends it away awkwardly, it goes off the glove towards mid-wicket for one.
Shorter again, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one more.

FOUR! 100 for Zaman! A superb knock from him. The whole dressing room is up on their feet, applauding the effort. It is shorter and on the body, this is pulled through backward square leg for a boundary.
A full toss on off, Zaman hits it hard down towards mid off. The fielder runs to his left and makes a half stop. Two taken. He is onto 99.
Fuller and on middle, Afridi strokes it to mid on.
A bumper, it is ducked under.

OUT! TAKEN! Phehlukwayo has another one! This is short and down the leg side. Ashraf goes for the pull but it takes the glove and de Kock does the rest. A wicket of a nothing delivery but South Africa won't care.
Shorter and on middle, Faheem pulls it to mid-wicket.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
FOUR! CUT AWAY! Shorter and outside off, Ashraf slashes at it. It goes wide of point for a boundary.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
One more single as Zaman strokes it to long off.
Fuller and on middle, Ashraf hits it down to long on and takes one.
A single this time as this is pushed down to long on.
Flatter again and on off, Zaman pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter and on off, this is guided to point.
Outside off, Faheem carves it through point for two.
Shorter, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, this is cut through point for one.
Just short! Shorter and outside off, it is cut uppishly but well short of the man at deep covers. One taken.
On the pads, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one more.
Good running! Shorter and on the body, this is pulled through square leg. Two taken.
Flighted ball on middle and Ashraf plays it back to Markram. Another excellent over from the part-timer.
Flighted ball on off and Fakhar punches it past covers and takes a quick run.
Short and wide outside off. Cut away but straight away to sweeper cover for one.
Tossed up, outside off. Ashraf puts in a stride and defends.
Flatter ball outside off and Fakhar runs it to short third man for one.
Loopy ball on middle and punched down to long on by Ashraf.
A length ball, right on off and Fakhar defends. Single is denied and Faheem Ashraf will face the next over.

OUT! TAKEN! A slow but good partnership comes to an end! Slower ball outside off and Ali looks to deposit it in the stands. He only manages a top edge and Aiden Markram takes a good catch and deep mid-wicket.
A touch shorter and wide outside off. Ali cuts it towards the backwad point fence for a couple.
Length ball, outside off and Fakhar pushes it past covers for one.
Short and wide outside off. Fakhar cuts it but Miller does well at point to stop this one.
SIX! Welcome to the attack says Fakhar Zaman. Length ball outside off and he comes down the track to slice it over point for a maximum.
Tossed up on middle and leg and Ali defends it.
Flatter ball, around off and punched to sweeper cover for one.
FOUR! Punished! Short and wide outside off. Fakhar flays it to the point fence.
Tossed up, on his pads. Ali looks to sweep but the ball rolls to short third man for one.
Tossed up on off and punched to long on for one.
Short and wide oustide off. Pushed to point.
FOUR! Ali gets away with a top edge this time! He was in no control of this pull shot but the top edge runs down to the fine leg fence.
Well bowled! Fires a full one on the stumps and Fakhar pushes it towards mid off and takes a quick single.
Pulled away for a couple! Short ball on off and Fakhar pulls it toward the square leg fence. Rabada runs to his left, dives and saves a couple of runs.
A touch fuller on the pads and Ali whips it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Short ball time, on off and pulled towards fine leg for one.
FOUR! Just over mid on and he will take it! Right in his slot and he goes for it, doesn't middle it but the ball goes over mid on and to the ropes.
Shorter one this time, defended from the crease. Excellent over by Markram.
Flighted ball, lands around off and Fakhar pushes it to long on for one.
Another dot! Loopy ball outside off and pushed to covers.
Loopy ball, on off and Fakhar defends it from the crease. 3 dots in a row.
A touch fuller this time, Fakhar pushes it to covers.
Tossed up, around off and defended by Fakhar.

Drinks has taken by the umpires. Interesting passage of play coming up. Pakistan have a mountain to climb and if the last few overs are an indication then will look to score quick runs now. South Africa, on the other will look to get Fakhar Zaman out as he is starting to look dangerous.
On middle, it is pushed back towards the bowler.
Shorter and outside off, Asif Ali looks to upper cut it but misses.
A loud appeal but that is too high! Angled into the leg pole, Asif hops and looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
A yorker now on middle, it is jammed back towards the mid off fielder for a quick run.
Zaman is now going after every ball! Length and on middle, he flat-bats it but to mid on.
A single as this is slapped through covers.
The pick of the bowlers, Anrich Nortje is back into the attack.
SIX! It is raining boundaries now! The slog is sweep is out now. Zaman has nailed it and he hits it a long way into the mid-wicket fence.
FOUR! That races away too! Second boundary in the over! This is short and wide outside off, Zaman cuts it through point and it races away to the fence.
Tossed up on middle, Ali works it through mid-wicket for one more. .
On middle, defended.
FOUR! Pulled and pulled hard! Shorter and on middle, Asif rocks back and hammers it through mid-wicket. It races away to the fence.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Shorter anjd on middle, defended. A good over for Pakistan.
On the shorter side, this is slapped through covers for one.
Good length and on off, this is guided to point.
FOUR! 10 from the first two balls! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket. Another boundary.

SIX! That has gone a long way! Fifty for Zaman and he brings it up in style. He is fighting a lone battle and needs to produce something very special if his side are to win this game. It is short and on the body, Zaman clears the front leg and tonks it over the square leg fence for a biggie.
Shorter and on off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Another single! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for a single.
A little too straight, this is worked through square leg for one.
Shorter and outside off, Ali looks to push at it but misses.
Tossed up on off, it is pushed to covers.
On middle, this is whipped towards deep mid-wicket for one more.
Tossed up on off, it is driven down to long on for one.
Length ball, around off. Fakhar taps it to off side and looks for a run but is sent back by Ali. Required rate now crosses 9 per over.
Full this time, on the pads and Ali clips it past mid-wicket for one.
Wide! Too short and down the leg side. Ali ducks under it and it is given a wide.
Fuller this time, outside off and Ali is solid in his defence.
Lands this on length, on middle and it nips back in. Ali looks to flick it but is hit on the thigh pad.
Short of a length, around off and Ali defends it.
Length ball, outside off and left alone by Ali.
Hit on the pads again but not given this time! Full one on middle and Fakhar looks for a sweep. He misses and is hit on the pads. Shamsi appeals but the umpire is unmoved.
A touch shorter this time, around off. Fakhar looks to run it past first slip but gets the bottom edge past the stumps.
Tossed up, outside off and pushed past covers for one.
Shadab Khan has gone for a review. Nothing on Ultra Edge. Three reds on Ball Tracker and Shadab is gone.

OUT! LBW! That was plumb! Tossed up on middle and Shadab goes for the sweep. He misses and is hit right in front of the stumps. The umpire raises his finger and Shadab reviews at the very last moment. Nothing on Ultra Edge and three reds on Ball Tracker. Pakistan lose another one and also a review.
Tossed up on off and punched back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, outside off and defended by Shadab.
Fuller this time, on off. Shadab looks to defend but gets the outside edge to third man for one.
Serves a length ball, around off. Punched to covers for a run by Fakhar.
Short and wide outside off. Left alone by Fakhar.
Short ball, around off. Fakhar looks to pull but miscues it deep mid-wicket for two.
Beaten! Length ball, lands on off and nips away to past Fakhar's outside edge.
Length ball, around off and pushed to mid off.
Kagiso Rabada is back on.
Flighted ball, on middle and leg. Shadab defends it back to Shamsi.
Loopy ball on off and Shadab works it to mid-wicket.
Too full and on the pads, Fakhar punches it to long on for a run.
Tossed up, around off. Defended by Fakhar.
Shorter this time, down the leg stump an Shadab flicks it to deep sqaure leg for one.
Full one, on middle and clipped to long for a run by Fakhar.
Back of length, outside off. Fakhar stands tall and taps it to point for a run.
Length ball, around off and defended.
4 Leg byes. Misses his line and gives away four runs! Angled on the pads, Fakhar looks to flick but the ball takes his pad past the diving keeper for a boundary.
Full one, outside off and Fakhar middles it, but straight to covers.
Fuller this time, around off. Fakhar defends it from the crease. The required rate now crosses 8 per over.
Good length, outside off and Fakhar shoulders his arms.
A touch shorter this time and it is clipped to the right of mid-wicket. The fielder dives to stop it.
Flatter one, around off and Shadab pushes it back to Shamsi.
Shorter this time, on the pads and the ball rolls down to short fine leg offn the pads.
Tossed up, on off. Pushed to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Well swept! Tossed up on the stumps and he sweeps this past short third man for a four.
Too full and down the leg side. Shadab goes for the sweep and misses. Wided.
Short and wide outside off. Cut away to sweeper cover for one.
Good length ball, sliding down the leg stump. Fakhar looks to glance it but it off his thigh pad down to fine leg for a leg bye.
FOUR! Finally a boundary for Pakistan! Short and wide outside off and Fakhar cuts it to the point fence.
Beaten! Beauty by Ngidi! Length ball, lands on off and nips away enough to go past Fakhar's attempted defence.
Good length ball, right on off stump and defended by Fakhar.
Length ball, around off and Fakhar defends. South Africa won't mind that as the required run rate in creeping up to 8 an over.
Good length ball, outside off. Shadab shuffles across and works it to third man reigon for one.
Full ball, around off and Fakhar digs it out.
Short, short, short, short and now a yorker! Right on his pads and Shadab fails to dig it out. The ball rolls away and they take a run.
Short stuff seems to be the plan! Outside off and Shadab miscues his pull to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Short ball again! Fakhar looks for the pull but gets the top edge towards deep mid-wicket. A single taken.
Shorter ball again, outside off and Fakhar again leaves it alone. The big fast bowler Nortje, says a few things to Fakhar.
Runs in and digs this one short, outside off. Fakhar sways away from the line. Good aggressive bowling from Nortje.
Length ball, on the pads and Fakhar clips it to square leg to keep the strike.
Full around middle and flicked away to fine leg for one.
Length ball, around middle and played back to Ngidi. He throws the ball back at the striker's end but hits Shadab's arm.

Beaten! Lands a length ball outside off and gets it to nip back in. Shadab looks to defend but the ball goes through the gate. It swinged so much that even de Kock had to dive to his left to collect it.
Misses out on that one! Short and wide outside off but Shadab cuts it straight to point.
Starts with a length ball, outside off. Shadab prods forward and plays it to point.
A touch shorter this time, lands on off and angles across. Fakhar sways away from it.
Length ball, on middle. Fakhar looks to pull it away but the ball smashes into his arm.
Back of a length and outside off. Shadab gets on top of the bounce and plays it to deep backward point for one.
Good length ball, around off. Shadab pushes it to point.
Short one by Nortje. Fakhar looks to pull but the ball goes over him. Even de Kock isn't able to collect it cleany and they sneak in a bye.
Fires a full one outside off and Fakhar digs it back to the bowler.
A touch straighter this time, it is clipped to mid-wicket for a run. Just 3 runs from the over, excellent by Andile Phehlukwayo.
Full ball, around off. Fakhar leans into it and drives it to covers.
Serves a length ball, a bit closer to the stumps and Fakhar defends it.
Length ball, outside off. Punched to covers by Fakhar.
Short and wide outside off. Shadab waits for it and then cuts it down to third man to get off the mark.
Full one, outside off. Drilled away to sweeper cover for one.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! Third for Nortje and it is almost a similar way to how Aziz got out in the first game. Length and angling away. Slightly shorter. Aziz looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge and de Kock does the rest.  Pakistan are staring down the barrel now.
FOUR! That is a snorter! A sharp bumper, Aziz looks to fend it away but it hits the glove, then the helmet and goes down to the fine leg fence.
BEATEN! Shortish and angling away, Azizi is beaten as he tries to block.
Shorter in length again, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Fuller and on middle, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Outside off, Zaman slashes at it but misses.

Drinks have been taken, a good period of play for both the teams. Pakistan has scored quick runs but South Africa has taken three big wickets. The middle overs are going to be crucial as a good partnership or a couple wickets can swing the game either way.
Angled into the pads, it is worked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! That should get Aziz going! Shorter and outside off, Aziz cuts it through point. The fielder in the deep runs to his right and slides but to no avail.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Aziz looks to pull but misses.
Lovely delivery! This lands on off and then straightens. Aziz is beaten as he tries to defend.
BEATEN! Full and outside off, Aziz goes after it with no foot movement. He is beaten.
Shorter and outside off, Zaman cuts it down towards third man for one.
Fullish again, Zaman this time finds the man at cover.
Fuller and on off, it is pushed to covers.
Beaten for pace! Shorter and angling away. Aziz looks to pull but is beaten.
That might have hurt! Shorter and on the body, Aziz looks to nudge it on the leg side but gets hit on the glove.
Length and on off, Azis gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
Back of a length and on off, defended.
Sharp! A bumper and on the body, ducked under.
Aziz is off the mark! Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
WIDE! A short one and it goes well over the batters head. Wided.
Finds the gap this time as he drives it through covers for one.
On the fuller side again, Zaman finds the cover fielder with his drive.
Fuller and on off, Zaman pushes it to mid off.
Back of a length and on off, Zaman guides it to point.
Good length and on off, defended.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Rizwan is out of here now and once again it is Nortje who is wrecking havoc. Not a good shot though this from Rizwan. It is a length delivery outside off. Could have left it but he pokes at it tentatively. An outside edge is induced which goes straight into the hands of widish first slip. So Pakistan's two best batters are back in the hut in one over itself.
One more short ball, Rizwan probably expected it as he ducks early.
WIDE! Very short and it goes well over the batter. Left alone. Wided.

OUT! DROPPED, NO IT HAS BEEN TAKEN! Bavuma hangs on! Nortje has got the big fish and the pacer continues his good form. The short ball does the trick for him again. It is outside off. Azam looks to drag his pull but gets a top edge. It goes towards mid on where Bavuma takes it on the third attempt. A timely wicket too as this stand was starting to flourish.
A short one, Azam lets it go to the keeper.
Back of a length and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Two! On the pads, this is worked through backward square leg for two.
End of Powerplay 1 and now 4 fielders can be plaed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Short and wide outside off. Cut away to sweeper cover for one. Pakistan are off to a flier here and have scored 68 runs in the poweplay.
FOUR! Three in a row and Azam is on fire here! Andile Phehlukwayo compensates by bowling it too straight on the pads and Azam has no problem in dispatching it to the square leg fence.
FOUR! More runs and runs are leaking now! Length ball, plenty of width on this one and Azam cashes in on it. The ball races it to the point boundary.
FOUR! He plays at this one and gets a boundary! Short and wide outside off, this one is closer to his body and Azam crunches it to the cover boundary. 50 partnership between the two.
Length ball, but wide outside off. Azam shoulders his arms and so does the umpire.
A touch fuller and straigter this time. Clipped to the vacant mid-wicket region for one.
Length ball, outside off. Fakhar taps it to covers looking for one but is sent back by Azam.
In the air...but safe! Length ball, around middle and Azam looks to work it to the leg side. The ball takes the leading edge and drops in front of point.
Good start by Pakistan here! It is their skipper who is leading from the front along with Zaman who needs some runs.
Short ball, but way down the leg side. Azam leaves it alone and it is given a wide.
Good length ball, around off and Azam defends.
Back of good length, around off and pushes to covers.
Doesn't carry to the fielder! Short and wide outside off. Fakhar goes for the cut but the ball lands just short of cover fielder. A single is taken.
FOUR! The boundaries are coming at will for Pakistan! This one brings up their 50! Short of a length, on off and pulled away to the square leg fence.
Good length ball, around middle and leg. Tucked away to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Ahhh yess, this is even better! Full and wide outside off and Fakhar bends his back leg and creams this past covers. 13 from the over.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Length ball, around off. Fakhar leans into it and simply pushes it through covers for four runs.

Swing and a miss! Length ball, on off and Fakhar goes for the slog to the leg side. The ball bounces a bit more than he expected and goes over his bat. Lungi Ngidi cannot believe that this hasn't taken the outside edge.
FOUR! Enough of leaving says Fakhar! He gets a short one and he swivels across and pulls it to square leg fence.
A touch fuller this time, lands on off and angles further away. Left alone this time.
Back of a length, outside off and it climbs on Azam. He stays inside the line and taps it down to third man for one.
Good length ball, around off stump and Fakhar leaves it alone. 11 runs and a life for Azam from that over.
Good length ball, around off. Azam plays it past point for one.
Wide! Too far down the leg side, wide given.
Dropped! That was hit very hard by Azam! Short and wide outside off. Azam cuts it and the ball is flying to the left of Miller at backward point. The ball doesn't stick in his palms.
Good length ball, on off and defended.
That went just over the stumps! Risky leave by Azam! Length ball, it lands on off and nips back in. Azam leaves but the ball goes just over the stumps.
FOUR! Shot! Geez that was timed well! Short and wide outside off and Azam creams it past covers and to the ropes.
5 Wides! Free runs for Pakistan. Short ball by Rabda but it goes way over Azam and the keeper.
Serves a length ball, it lands on middle and nips back in. Azam looks to flick but is hit on the pads. The ball rolls away and they take one. 10 runs from the over.
Good length ball, around off and Azam defends it watchfully.
FOUR! Poor delivery and Azam punishes it! Too full but way down the leg side. Azam helps it to the fine leg fence.
Full ball, around off. Fakhar plays it to mid off and sets off for a run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
FOUR! Nicely played! Length ball outside off and he slices it past covers and to the ropes.
Full ball, on the pads and pushed to mid off.
Back of a length ball, around middle. Azam looks to play it through the on side but ends up hitting it back to Rabada.
Fuller ball, around middle and leg. Blocked by Azam.
A touch shorter this time, Azam looks to pull it but the ball drops just short of short mid-wicket.
Hits the deck on a length, around off and Azam is solid in his defence.
Short and around off. Azam pushes it to covers.
A touch short and on off. Azam defends it well.
Full ball, on middle and leg. Azam maintains his balance and punches it to mid on for a run.
Good length ball, on the sixth stump line. Azam shoulders his arms.
FOUR! Class from Azam! Overpitched ball on off and he nails it down the ground. It hits the bowler's boot but still runs to fence.
Serves a length ball, around off and Azam offers a solid front foot defence.
Full one, on middle and leg. Azam middles the drive, but sraight to mid on.
Good length ball, lands outside off and nips back in. Azam looks to defend but gets an inside edge back onto his pads.
A touch fuller, but wide outside off. Fakhar doesn't offer a stroke. Maiden over by Rabada.
Right channels by Rabda. Right the corridor and Fakhar leaves it alone.
A touch shorter, it lands outside off and takes off. Fakhar shoulders his arms this time.
Length ball, around off. Left alone by Fakhar.

NOT OUT! Inside edge says the TV umpire. Rabada fires a full one, the ball nips back in through the air and hits Fakhar on the boots. South Africa appeal but it is turned down. Bavuma takes the review at the last second. At first, it looks like inside edge but Ultra Edge shows that its very close. In the end the TV umpire decides that it is indeed an inside edge.
Review time! A huge shout for an LBW has been turned down. Does not look out.
Length ball, Fakhar goes for the flick but is hit high on the pads.
Babar Azam walks out to bat! A century in the last game and he needs a similar effort here.

OUT! TAKEN! There it is! This one carries and the man in form is gone! Length ball, around off. Imam looks to play it from the crease but the ball nips away a bit and takes the edge. It would have fallen short of first slip but Markram, who is at second slip dives to his right to take it.
Falls short for de Kock! Length ball, outside off. Imam leaves this one too late and gets the bottom edge to de Kock, but on the bounce.
A touch fuller this time, but outside off. Imam lets it go through.
Length ball, right on the fourth stump line. Imam shouders his arms and the ball carries through well to de Kock.
FOUR! Nicely struck! Too full on his pads and Imam flicks it past mid-wicket and to the fence.
Starts with a full one, on the pads. Clipped down to fine leg for one run.
Fires a full one on the pads, Imam looks to flick it but misses. He is rapped on the pads, but the ball is probably sliding down. Just 2 from the over.
Length ball, on the pads. Fakhar tucks it to fine leg to get off the mark.
A touch fuller, around middle and it is clipped away towards mid-wicket for one. Imam and Pakistan are underway.
Smell the leather says Rabada! Short ball around off and Imam ducks under it.
Length ball, around off and defended.
Wow! What a way to start! Hits the deck on a length and it keeps rising on the batter. Imam does well to defend it in the end.
